title: Candidate estimator work bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be any target function, let $0<\tau\le 1$ be a rational threshold, and let $J$ and $P$ be subsets of the $n$ coordinates. Every outcome in the support of the candidate-estimation program run with inputs $\tau,J,P$ has work cost at most $8(m+1)(n+1)$, where $m$ is the sample count for accuracy $\tau^2/4$ and confidence parameter $1/[40(n+1)(\lceil4/\tau^2\rceil+1)]$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a target function from the sign cube to the signs
$J$ and $P$ are subsets of the $n$ coordinates
the outcome belongs to the support of the specified program run
